note: word-passed-facts: which finding of the S5 exit is which FACT a person's recorded word passed (`facts`: the finding's check and tag, exact or prefix), and which tests[] row fields that word may pass (`row_fields`: a field with no row, or a row with pass false, is NEVER passed: the safe default is that the field is deleted when empty and refused as before). The one reader is waiver.word_passed_index (and waiver.row_fields); no other script keeps a (check, tag) list or a field list. A pass whose (check, tag) matches no `facts` row is fact `other`: a report line only, read by no gate. `words` is the wording of each fact for the report. `not_run` is what a `not_run` word lets go at the S5 finish (shape lines, tier-4 gap kinds); `row_fields[f].tier4_gaps` is what a passed field lets go; both are read by window_record.word_let_go through waiver.not_run_lets_go and waiver.row_fields.

change_basis_ref.why: the basis is the evidence of the disposition, and an `unchanged` disposition switches off the probe demand (proof_level._wanted): an empty basis would let an unsupported `unchanged` keep it off

change_disposition.why: an empty value switches off the probe demand (contract.py probe-missing line; proof_level.proof_required)

input_hash.why: an empty value makes the item malformed_instance and skips every later check of it (acceptance.validate_window)

words.then_unbound: Then not bound to a test
words.other: the finding stays as it was
